title: chore(deps-dev): bump rollup-plugin-visualizer from 6.0.5 to 7.0.0
body:
Bumps [rollup-plugin-visualizer](https://github.com/btd/rollup-plugin-visualizer) from 6.0.5 to 7.0.0.
Changelog

Sourced from rollup-plugin-visualizer's changelog.

7.0.0

  • Breaking change Migrate package to ESM-only
  • Breaking change Drop NodeJS 20, minimal version is 22
  • Added rolldown RC versions to peer deps
  • Add markdown report template (LLM-friendly)

6.0.8

  • Not published (rolled back, moved to 7.0.0)

6.0.7

  • Not published (moved to 7.0.0)

6.0.6
